data.name: AppCommands_Root
data.value: Azure Service Bus CLI and terminal UI: browse, peek, retry and send messages

data.name: AppCommands_Run
data.value: Open the terminal UI (the default command)

data.name: AppCommands_Config
data.value: Read and write settings in the config file, like git config: get <key>: print a value, exit code 1 when unset; unset <key>: remove it set <key> <value>: true/false and integers are stored as such, the rest as text list [--all]: print key=value lines, secrets masked; path: print the config file's path

data.name: AppCommands_Plugins
data.value: List the plugins, whether they are enabled, and their settings

data.name: AppCommands_Help
data.value: Show help for azsb or one of its commands

data.name: AppCommands_SubscriptionOption
data.value: Azure subscription to start in, by name or ID; emulator for the local emulator

data.name: AppCommands_NamespaceOption
data.value: Namespace of that subscription to open, by name or host name; needs --subscription

data.name: AppCommands_OpenOption
data.value: Queue, topic or topic/subscription of that namespace to open, by exact name; /dlq or /active picks the tab. Or a list: queues, topics or subscriptions. Needs --namespace

data.name: AppCommands_ThemeOption
data.value: Colors for a dark or light terminal background: auto (default; COLORFGBG, else dark), dark or light; overrides ui.theme

data.name: AppCommands_ActionArgument
data.value: get, set, unset, list or path

data.name: AppCommands_AllOption
data.value: With list: also the known keys that are unset, with their default and description

data.name: ConfigCommand_Usage
data.value: usage: azsb config get <key> | set <key> <value> | unset <key> | list [--all] | path

data.name: RunCommand_InvalidTheme
data.value: theme '{theme}' is not auto, dark or light (--theme, else {key}).

data.name: AppCommands_Check
data.value: Check that a namespace can be used from here: Azure sign-in, DNS, the AMQP port and a peek

data.name: AppCommands_List
data.value: List queues and subscriptions (or one kind) with their message counts

data.name: AppCommands_Peek
data.value: Print messages of a queue or subscription without changing them

data.name: AppCommands_Retry
data.value: Send dead-lettered messages back to their queue or topic and remove them from the dead-letter queue

data.name: AppCommands_Delete
data.value: Delete dead-lettered messages by message ID or sequence number

data.name: AppCommands_Purge
data.value: Delete every message of a queue or subscription, or of its dead-letter queue

data.name: AppCommands_Send
data.value: Send a new message to a queue or topic

data.name: AppCommands_ScriptSubscriptionOption
data.value: Azure subscription, by name or ID; emulator for the local emulator. Default: the Azure CLI's current subscription

data.name: AppCommands_ScriptNamespaceOption
data.value: Namespace, by name, host name or a pattern with * that matches one. Default: the subscription's only namespace

data.name: AppCommands_ConfirmOption
data.value: The namespace's name: needed for changes in a namespace listed in cli.protect

data.name: AppCommands_ListKindArgument
data.value: queues, topics or subscriptions; default: queues and subscriptions

data.name: AppCommands_EntityArgument
data.value: Queue or topic/subscription; topic/Subscriptions/subscription and a /$DeadLetterQueue suffix work too

data.name: AppCommands_SendTargetArgument
data.value: Queue or topic to send to

data.name: AppCommands_FromSequenceOption
data.value: Peek from this sequence number on

data.name: AppCommands_FullOption
data.value: Print whole bodies; longer ones are cut at 4 KB otherwise

data.name: AppCommands_MessageIdOption
data.value: Message ID to act on, repeatable; every message with that ID

data.name: AppCommands_SequenceOption
data.value: Sequence number to act on, repeatable

data.name: AppCommands_LimitOption
data.value: How many messages from the front to look through

data.name: AppCommands_DryRunOption
data.value: Show which messages match without changing anything

data.name: AppCommands_FileOption
data.value: File with the message body; without --body or --file the body is read from standard input

data.name: AppCommands_SendMessageIdOption
data.value: Message ID; default: a new one

data.name: CheckCommand_SignInHint
data.value: Sign in with az login, or pass --subscription and --namespace

data.name: CheckCommand_DnsHint
data.value: Check the host name; a namespace behind a private endpoint resolves only inside its network (VPN)

data.name: CheckCommand_PortPrivateHint
data.value: The address is private but unreachable: connect the VPN, or check the network rules

data.name: CheckCommand_PortPublicHint
data.value: A firewall blocks the port; or the namespace accepts only private endpoint traffic and its DNS should resolve to a private address (connect the VPN)

data.name: CheckCommand_NothingToPeek
data.value: no queues or subscriptions to peek

data.name: CheckCommand_PeekHint
data.value: Needs the Azure Service Bus Data Receiver (or Owner) role on the namespace, its resource group or subscription; a namespace that only takes private endpoint traffic fails the same way from outside its network

data.name: CommandContext_Protected
data.value: {namespaceName} is protected ({key}): add --confirm {namespaceName} to change it

data.name: DeleteCommand_NeedsDlq
data.value: delete removes dead-lettered messages only: add --dlq

data.name: DeleteCommand_DryRun
data.value: Dry run, nothing changed: {count} message(s) in {source} would be deleted

data.name: RetryCommand_DryRun
data.value: Dry run, nothing changed: {count} message(s) in {source} would be retried

data.name: NamespaceTarget_NoSubscription
data.value: No --subscription, and the Azure CLI has no current subscription: run az login

data.name: NamespaceTarget_SubscriptionNotFound
data.value: No subscription {subscription} for the signed-in account

data.name: NamespaceTarget_NoNamespaces
data.value: Subscription {subscription} has no Service Bus namespaces

data.name: NamespaceTarget_PickNamespace
data.value: Subscription {subscription} has several namespaces, pick one with --namespace: {names}

data.name: SendCommand_NoBody
data.value: No body: pass --body or --file, or pipe it in
